stories.title: Who decided Flintshire taxpayers should pay £8.25m for Catholic schools? Councillor wants answers
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council has been asked who decided it should pay £8.25m towards modernising Catholic schools in the county, and when. Cllr Andrew Parkhurst (Cilcain, Liberal Democrats) raised the question at the council’s Corporate Resources Overview and Scrutiny Committee on Thursday. stories.title: North Wales Police chief to face MPs over plans to merge police forces
stories.summary: North Wales Police Chief Constable Amanda Blakeman will be questioned by MPs next week over UK Government plans that could see her force merged into a larger one.
